capabilities: Disable click-to-source switching inside callouts in Live Preview
Keep callouts rendered until the edit button is clicked
extras: README notes it relies on undocumented Obsidian behavior, so it may break on future Obsidian updates. Documentation is minimal: one paragraph plus a limitations note, with no usage or troubleshooting detail.
intentEvidence: In Live Preview, clicking anywhere inside a callout switches it to its raw Markdown. This plugin turns that off.
problem: In Live Preview, clicking anywhere inside a callout switches it to its raw Markdown source, which interrupts reading and makes selecting text awkward.
summary: Live Preview tweak that stops callouts from switching to raw Markdown on click, so they only enter edit mode via their edit button.
